trans-unit.source: The OTEL_* settings only take effect when the app registers an OpenTelemetry SDK. For Node.js apps, install @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node and start the app with --require @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node/register. An idle app may also have nothing to report yet.
